text: Northwind Robotics reported total revenue of $812.4 million in fiscal 2025, compared with $706.9 million in fiscal 2024.
The warehouse automation segment generated $524.0 million of revenue in fiscal 2025, and the field services segment generated $288.4 million.
Gross margin was 41.3% in fiscal 2025, down from 43.0% in fiscal 2024, mainly due to higher component costs.
Research and development expense was $97.2 million in fiscal 2025. The company employed 3,150 people at year end, including 940 engineers.
Net income was $61.8 million in fiscal 2025, compared with $48.5 million in fiscal 2024.
Cash and cash equivalents were $214.7 million at the end of fiscal 2025. Long-term debt was $350.0 million.
Bluecrest Foods net sales were $3.42 billion in 2025, an increase from $3.18 billion in 2024.
Organic volume grew 2.6% in 2025, while pricing contributed 4.1% to net sales growth.
Operating income was $412 million in 2025 and operating margin was 12.0%.
Advertising and promotion spending was $186 million in 2025, compared with $171 million in 2024.
The company operated 14 manufacturing plants and employed approximately 9,800 people as of December 31, 2025.
Diluted earnings per share were $2.87 in 2025 and $2.51 in 2024. The quarterly dividend was raised to $0.62 per share.
Halcyon Health served 1.24 million patients in 2025 across 63 clinics.
Patient service revenue was $1,905 million in 2025, up from $1,742 million in 2024.
Salaries and benefits were $1,103 million, or 57.9% of patient service revenue, in 2025.
Capital expenditures were $128.6 million in 2025, of which $41.2 million related to new clinic openings.
The average length of stay was 3.8 days in 2025 and the readmission rate was 9.4%.
Net loss was $(23.5) million in 2025, compared with net income of $12.9 million in 2024.
Vantor Cloud annual recurring revenue reached $268 million at the end of 2025, up 34% year over year.
Net revenue retention was 118% in 2025, and the company had 1,420 customers with more than $100,000 of annual recurring revenue.
Subscription revenue was $241.3 million in 2025 and professional services revenue was $19.8 million.
Non-GAAP operating margin improved to 8.5% in 2025 from negative 3.2% in 2024.
Free cash flow was $31.7 million in 2025. Stock-based compensation expense was $46.9 million.
The company had 1,860 employees at year end, of whom 47% worked in research and development.
